title: Surreal Desert Mouse Shaman
description: A surreal desert scene at night featuring a large brown mouse in a hooded robe standing on a stone platform, holding a giant rainbow swirl lollipop. Skeletal horses gallop across sand dunes under a dark sky with a massive melting Nike swoosh moon, while a blue horse pulls a cart of lollipops below. Small human figures worship a glowing mouse logo in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal desert night scene with a large anthropomorphic mouse shaman wearing a brown hooded robe and braids, standing on a stone platform holding a giant rainbow swirl lollipop. Skeletal horses run across cracked sand dunes in the background. A blue horse pulls a wooden cart filled with lollipops. Foreground shows small silhouetted human figures worshipping a glowing green circular mouse logo. Massive moon in the sky shaped like a melting Nike swoosh with dripping colors against a red and yellow nebula, detailed digital painting style.
